messages:
sam_engineer: Hey team, weird edge case: I'm moving to EU on Dec 20 and there9s a company holiday on Dec 26. My FT start in the EU office is Dec 24. Do I get holiday pay even though my timezone/start paperwork finalizes after the holiday?

mina_hr: Congrats on the move! :airplane: Company holidays are paid if you9re on payroll on that date. If your FT start date is Dec 24 and payroll shows you as active on 12/26, you should get holiday pay. If paperwork delays your payroll activation, we need to make a special payroll note.

sam_engineer: Payroll team said international onboarding sometimes delays the first payroll run. If payroll can't make the date, can we count it as a vacation hour credit instead of losing it?

leo_payroll: We can make an ad-hoc adjustment but it requires HR approval + manager confirmation. Options: 1) treat the holiday as paid retroactively when payroll runs, or 2) issue an equivalent vacation credit. We rarely give credits without documentation.

jon_manager: From a manager POV I approve option 2 if paperwork blocks payroll. Mina, can you confirm process? I9ll DM approvals.

mina_hr: Process: manager approval in thread + HR ticket. Submit a "Holiday Payroll Exception" form (link: https://intranet.redwood/forms/holiday-exception) and attach onboarding notes. HR/Payroll will resolve within one pay cycle. Peopleops_bot will log the ticket.

peopleops_bot: Reminder: Handbook - Holidays & Start Dates: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/leave#holidays (v3.7).

sam_engineer: Another Q: if I9m moving across timezones and the holiday falls on my local weekend, do we observe local country holidays or the company US calendar?

mina_hr: We observe local country official holidays for employees based in that country. For global company holidays we have a list per region. If a regional holiday overlaps with the company holiday policy, payroll applies local rules. See region list in the handbook.

leo_payroll: FYI carryover note: if you end the year with unused vacation and have < 40h, we auto-roll up to cap. If we need to issue a credit instead of holiday pay, that credit will count as vacation and follow carry rules.

sam_engineer: Thanks all. Jon I9ll send the manager approval DM and file the form. Appreciate the quick answers.

jon_manager: Approved. Please include expected payroll activation date in the form so payroll can plan.

mina_hr: Filing note: HR ticket #HR-12984 opened. We9ll update when payroll completes the fix. If anything blocks, ping me.
